title: Humanize MLE Agents: Multi-Agent Session Alternation Beyond Single-Agent Limits
abstract: arXiv:2610.13494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing LLM-based agent approaches for long-horizon machine learning engineering (MLE) often use context engineering, implemented through custom harnesses that manage tools, skills, and accumulated experience. However, we find that as single-session execution lengthens, the agent's reasoning intensity declines alongside slowing progress, summarized as long-horizon deceleration, and the benefits of these custom harnesses vanish as the underlying model improves, summarized as harness staleness. These findings suggest that their benefits may not persist across versions, which motivates a workflow-level approach in which agents build on one another's work across sessions. translated_title: 人性化MLE智能体：超越单智能体极限的多智能体会话交替
translated_abstract: 现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的长时程机器学习工程（MLE）智能体方法通常采用上下文工程技术，通过自定义执行框架来管理工具、技能和积累的经验。然而，我们发现随着单次会话执行时间的延长，智能体的推理强度会下降且进展放缓，我们将其总结为“长时程减速”；同时，随着底层模型的改进，这些自定义框架的收益会逐渐消失，我们将其总结为“框架过时”。这些发现表明，此类框架的收益可能无法在不同模型版本间持续存在，这促使我们提出一种工作流层面的方法，让智能体在跨会话中相互承接彼此的工作成果。我们将这种交替进行的智能体会话建模为上下文重置半马尔可夫决策过程（CR-SMDP），建立了交替模式超越单智能体参考极限的充分条件，推导出明确的实验预算上界，并刻画了会话上限在何种条件下……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出将多个智能体的会话交替协作建模为上下文重置半马尔可夫决策过程（CR-SMDP），通过工作流层面的跨会话协作突破单智能体的性能极限，从而克服长时程减速与框架过时问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes modeling alternating multi-agent sessions as a context-reset semi-Markov decision process (CR-SMDP), enabling agents to build on each other's work across sessions to surpass single-agent limits and overcome long-horizon deceleration and harness staleness.
